dct_description_sm:
This dataset was created to give a regional overview of Yukon and the surrounding jurisdictions for visual representation only. The borders are not intended to provide a legal representation of the Yukon border. The data is referenced at approximately 1:1,000,000.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps). Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
